en.title: Hidden Camera Found in Accessible Toilet Sparks Nationwide Outcry
en.summary: Hidden camera discovered inside a potted plant in an accessible toilet filmed 25 users, prompting public outrage and investigations. Meanwhile, Australia extended its Disability Representative Program for two years, and Bolt launched e‑scooter‑derived maps to improve wheelchair navigation. Other developments include funding renewals for inclusive employment, a new digital accessibility recognition scheme, assistive‑device flyers, and debate on accommodation versus inclusion.

highlights.title: Hidden camera discovered in accessible toilet's potted plant, secretly filming 25 users
Disability Representative Program Extended for Two Years
Bolt Turns E‑scooters into Maps for Wheelchair Accessibility

2026-2027 Digital Accessibility Recognition Scheme Now Accepting Applications
Flyer on assistive devices and home accessibility improvements

zh-TW.title: 無障礙廁所發現偷拍鏡頭 引發社會廣泛關注
zh-TW.summary: 無障礙廁所內的盆栽被發現藏有偷拍鏡頭，秘密錄下25人使用畫面，引發公眾憤怒與調查。同時，澳洲政府將殘障代表計畫延長兩年，Bolt 則利用電子滑板車數據製作輪椅無障礙路線圖。其他發展包括「備好、願意且有能力」計畫尋求經費續撥、2026‑2027 年度數碼無障礙嘉許計劃開放申請、輔具家居改善宣傳單張，以及關於無障礙是否僅為便利措施的討論。
